text:
Elena R.: Quick brief  need creative for "Serving Wins" launch. Deliverables: webinar hero, blog hero, social teaser, 3 microtiles (latency/cost/reliability), inbound banner (A/B). Deadline: Thu EOD.
Tom B.: Confirming copy variants A/B and numbers?
Elena R.: Copy A: 'Serve LLMs  predictable, low-cost inference.' Copy B: 'Optimized runtime + smart routing = stable latencies and lower token spend.' Short webinar CTA: 'Live: Serving Wins  numbers & tradeoffs'.
Maya D.: Brand rules?
Elena R.: Primary palette only, Inter weights regular/semibold, logo lockup required, no condensed. Legal note: 'Benchmarks run on representative infra; results may vary.'
Priya S.: Data for tiles: p50 tuned 30ms vs baseline 130ms; token cost tuned $0.011 vs $0.018 (claim: ~40% lower). Reliability: '99.95% with fallbacks'.
design-bot: Created ticket MK-4901 (assignee: Maya D., due: 2026-02-11).
Maya D.: Figma will have two directions: data-viz-forward and schematic. Prioritize data viz for microtiles, schematic for webinar hero. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/serving-wins
Tom B.: Export spec:
``
webinar_hero: 1600x900 png + 3200x1800 @2x
blog_hero: 1200x628 jpg
social_teaser: 1200x630 png
microtile: 360x240 png (3)
banner: 1200x300 png + 2400x600 @2x
```
Maya D.: I'll drop frames tonight; please paste final shortlines into Figma copy. Priya will add alt text.
Priya S.: Adding alt-texts and accessibility notes. QA: lock copy 24h before export.
Elena R.: Thanks  ping when frames ready for review. :rocket:
